name: studio
description: Studio — song → stem → MIDI → editable piano-roll, ergonomic bass tab, and drum tab. Ships as a free web app (offline editor + asset library) and a Windows desktop app with the full local-GPU AI pipeline (Demucs · basic-pitch · ADTOF · yt-dlp).
_workspaces: worker/ declares better-auth + drizzle-orm in its OWN package.json (see the notes in there for why it is a separate manifest). Listing it as a workspace is what makes the root `npm clean-install` install those deps — and that is not a convenience, it is the deploy. Cloudflare Pages/Workers CI runs exactly one install, at the repo root, then `npx wrangler deploy`; esbuild resolves worker/*.js imports by walking UP to the root node_modules. Drop this key and the build goes green locally (worker/node_modules exists on a dev box) and dies in CI with `Could not resolve "better-auth"`. There is deliberately no worker/package-lock.json: npm ignores nested lockfiles inside a workspace, so a second one would only rot.
